title: Chandigarh University's CUBIC Partners with 247VC to Expand Investment Framework for Deep-Tech Startups - Quantum Computing Report
author: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
text:
The Centre for University-Led Innovation and Commercialization (CUBIC) at Chandigarh University has executed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with venture capital firm 247VC Investment Trust. Signed during the PRAGATI Q-Foundry 2026 NQM Co-development and Venture Partnership Meet in New Delhi, the agreement establishes a structured investment and mentorship pipeline for quantum and deep-tech startups operating within the university’s incubation ecosystem.

Organized under the auspices of India’s National Quantum Mission (NQM) and the Ministry of Science and Technology, PRAGATI Q-Foundry 2026 focuses on transitioning academic quantum research toward industrial validation, co-development, and commercial deployment. CUBIC, serving as an academic and incubation partner for the national initiative, will identify eligible seed-stage and early-stage ventures in quantum computing, sensing, communications, and photonics to facilitate direct deal flow, pitch sessions, and due diligence reviews with 247VC and its syndicate networks.

The framework assists academic spin-offs in preparing institutional pitch materials, establishing IP valuation models, and securing follow-on capital. CUBIC’s mandate covers quantum hardware and software alongside adjacent deep-tech verticals, including semiconductor design, integrated photonics, advanced materials, and robotics.
